name: Extinguisher XRtool
summary: Extinguisher XRtool is an extended reality tool that lets you build your own custom fire control environment, choosing the ignition points you want, right inside your personal space and across any other rooms you've scanned with Meta Quest. But more than that, it serves as a complementary training solution for any organization or workplace looking to effectively prepare their employees for fire emergencies.
